context: Evaluates correct use of the tunnel math utility functions for procedural path generation and camera transform computation. Tests that generateCurvePoints, createTunnelCurve, and getCameraTransform are correctly called with appropriate parameters and that return types match expected THREE.js objects.

checklist.name: generateCurvePoints Usage
checklist.description: generateCurvePoints(segmentIndex, pointCount) is called with appropriate arguments, returning an array of THREE.Vector3 with length equal to pointCount

checklist.name: createTunnelCurve Usage
checklist.description: createTunnelCurve(segmentIndex) is used to create a CatmullRomCurve3, which is then used for sampling with getPointAt(t)

checklist.name: getCameraTransform Usage
checklist.description: getCameraTransform(curve, progress, lookAheadDistance) is called with a CatmullRomCurve3, a progress value [0, 0.99], and a look-ahead distance, returning position/lookAt/up vectors

checklist.name: lerp/smoothStep Usage
checklist.description: lerp(start, end, factor) or smoothStep(edge0, edge1, x) is used for interpolation in transition animations or effect blending

checklist.name: TUNNEL_CONFIG Constants
checklist.description: TUNNEL_CONFIG constants (CURVE_SEGMENTS, CURVE_LENGTH, CURVE_AMPLITUDE, etc.) are referenced for default parameter values
